note.zh: 苏姿丰宣布与英特尔及其他创始成员共同成立x86生态系统顾问小组，共同规划x86架构的未来发展。

title.zh: Last week was amazing - always love launching new @AMD EPYC, Instinct, Pensando and Ryzen products with our partners, customers and developers! Special thanks t

note.zh: 苏姿丰总结了AMD在EPYC、Instinct、Pensando和锐龙等新产品发布周的成果，并感谢云计算与AI合作伙伴的支持。

title.zh: Closing Bell Overtime: AMD CEO Lisa Su On New AI Chip, Growing Market Share 10/10/24

title.zh: 10 years ago I had the honor of a lifetime to be named @AMD CEO. It’s been an incredible journey with so many proud moments. Today I want to thank the global @A

note.en: Marked her 10th anniversary as AMD CEO, reflecting on the company's turnaround and growth over the decade.
note.zh: 苏姿丰纪念其担任AMD首席执行官十周年，回顾了公司十年间的转型与增长历程。

title.en: Looking forward to seeing new Copilot+ PCs enabled with our @AMDRyzen AI 300 series later this year! Thanks for the great partnership @pavandavuluri - lots more
title.zh: Looking forward to seeing new Copilot+ PCs enabled with our @AMDRyzen AI 300 series later this year! Thanks for the great partnership @pavandavuluri - lots more

note.en: Previewed upcoming Copilot+ PCs powered by AMD's Ryzen AI 300 series in partnership with Microsoft.
note.zh: 苏姿丰预告了与微软合作、搭载AMD锐龙AI 300系列处理器的即将推出的Copilot+ PC。

title.en: Very excited to announce we have signed an agreement to acquire leading hyperscale solutions provider @ZTSystems. Next major step in our AI strategy combining o
title.zh: Very excited to announce we have signed an agreement to acquire leading hyperscale solutions provider @ZTSystems. Next major step in our AI strategy combining o

note.en: Announced an agreement to acquire hyperscale solutions provider ZT Systems, a major step in AMD's AI infrastructure strategy.
note.zh: 苏姿丰宣布已签署协议收购超大规模解决方案提供商ZT Systems，这是AMD AI基础设施战略的重要一步。

title.en: Huge welcome to @petersarlin and @silo_AI team! So happy to have you join @AMD!
title.zh: Huge welcome to @petersarlin and @silo_AI team! So happy to have you join @AMD!

note.en: Welcomed Silo AI co-founder Peter Sarlin and the Silo AI team to AMD, strengthening AMD's AI talent following the acquisition.
note.zh: 苏姿丰欢迎Silo AI联合创始人Peter Sarlin及其团队加入AMD，此次收购增强了AMD的AI人才储备。

title.en: Super excited to welcome the @silo_AI team to @AMD - adding a phenomenal team of AI scientists and engineers to accelerate the adoption of AMD AI solutions and
title.zh: Super excited to welcome the @silo_AI team to @AMD - adding a phenomenal team of AI scientists and engineers to accelerate the adoption of AMD AI solutions and

note.en: Welcomed the Silo AI team to AMD, adding AI scientists and engineers to accelerate adoption of AMD's open-source AI software.
note.zh: 苏姿丰欢迎Silo AI团队加入AMD，为公司增添AI科学家和工程师，以加速AMD开源AI软件的普及。

title.en: Congratulations @Azure on the launch of the Azure AI infrastructure VM series powered by @AMD Instinct MI300X! We are celebrating this milestone with you and ap
title.zh: Congratulations @Azure on the launch of the Azure AI infrastructure VM series powered by @AMD Instinct MI300X! We are celebrating this milestone with you and ap

note.en: Lisa Su marked the launch of Microsoft Azure's new AI infrastructure VM series powered by AMD Instinct MI300X, a concrete data-center design win for AMD silicon.
note.zh: 苏姿丰宣布微软Azure推出由AMD Instinct MI300X驱动的全新AI基础设施虚拟机系列，这是AMD芯片在数据中心领域的一项实际中标案例。

title.en: Thank you @IEEEorg for recognizing Team @AMD with the 2024 Corporate Innovation Award for our work on chiplet architecture and designs. We made a big bet 10 yea
title.zh: Thank you @IEEEorg for recognizing Team @AMD with the 2024 Corporate Innovation Award for our work on chiplet architecture and designs. We made a big bet 10 yea

note.en: Lisa Su noted AMD received the IEEE 2024 Corporate Innovation Award for its chiplet architecture work, recognition for a bet the company made a decade earlier.
note.zh: 苏姿丰宣布AMD凭借chiplet（芯粒）架构方面的工作获得IEEE 2024年度企业创新奖，这是对公司十年前所下赌注的认可。

title.zh: Amazing watching the total eclipse in Austin this afternoon with Team @AMD 😁 https://t.co/FNi2lf5RNC

note.en: A personal post about watching the total solar eclipse with the AMD team drew far higher engagement than her typical posts — nearly 600,000 views versus her usual tens of thousands.
note.zh: 苏姿丰与AMD团队一同观看日全食的个人动态获得远超她平时水平的互动，浏览量接近60万，远高于她通常的数万次。

title.zh: Lisa Su CEO of AMD

note.zh: In Good Company 访谈，谈半导体对全球经济的重要性，以及她如何完成科技业最大规模的转型之一。

title.zh: 单季 AI 数据中心收入 58 亿美元；Meta 签下 6GW 协议

title.zh: 与 OpenAI 达成 6 吉瓦 GPU 合作

body.en: First 1GW of MI450 deploys in H2 2026. AMD issued OpenAI a conditional warrant for up to 160M shares — roughly 10% of AMD if fully exercised.
body.zh: 首个 1 吉瓦 MI450 于 2026 下半年部署。AMD 向 OpenAI 发行最多 1.6 亿股的附条件认股权证，全部行权约占 AMD 10%。

title.en: Amid controversy over artificial intelligence (AI) speed control, AMD CEO Lisa Su emphasized opennes..
title.zh: Amid controversy over artificial intelligence (AI) speed control, AMD CEO Lisa Su emphasized opennes..

body.en: Amid debate over AI development pace, Su emphasizes AMD's commitment to open computing platforms.
body.zh: 在AI发展速度引发争议之际，苏姿丰强调了AMD对开放计算平台的坚持。

title.en: AMD CEO Lisa Su on Saudi Arabia’s $10 billion AI investment & HUMAIN partnership
title.zh: AMD CEO Lisa Su on Saudi Arabia’s $10 billion AI investment & HUMAIN partnership

body.en: Su discussed AMD's HUMAIN partnership tied to Saudi Arabia's $10 billion AI investment, extending AMD's push into new sovereign AI markets.
body.zh: 苏姿丰谈及AMD与HUMAIN的合作，该合作与沙特阿拉伯100亿美元的AI投资相关，标志AMD进一步拓展主权AI市场。

title.en: AMD CEO Lisa Su on Saudi Arabia’s $10 billion AI investment & HUMAIN partnership
title.zh: AMD CEO Lisa Su on Saudi Arabia’s $10 billion AI investment & HUMAIN partnership

body.en: AMD CEO Lisa Su discussed Saudi Arabia's $10 billion AI investment and a new partnership with HUMAIN.
body.zh: AMD首席执行官苏姿丰谈及沙特阿拉伯100亿美元的人工智能投资以及与HUMAIN的新合作。

title.en: 苏姿丰：未来10年的新发现，可能超过过去30年
title.zh: 苏姿丰：未来10年的新发现，可能超过过去30年

body.en: Lisa Su said discoveries over the next decade could exceed those of the past 30 years, a notable public statement on AI's trajectory.
body.zh: 苏姿丰表示未来十年的新发现可能超过过去30年，这是她对AI发展轨迹的一个值得关注的公开表态。

title.en: AMD Is Investing More Than $10 Billion in Taiwan to Build Advanced Chip Packaging With TSMC. Here's What Lisa Su Is Actually Buying With That Money.
title.zh: AMD Is Investing More Than $10 Billion in Taiwan to Build Advanced Chip Packaging With TSMC. Here's What Lisa Su Is Actually Buying With That Money.

body.en: AMD, under Lisa Su, is investing more than $10 billion in Taiwan to build advanced chip packaging capacity with TSMC.
body.zh: 在苏姿丰领导下，AMD将投资超过100亿美元，与台积电在台湾建设先进芯片封装产能。

title.en: Lisa Su Puts Rack-scale AI at Center of AMD’s Next Growth Phase
title.zh: Lisa Su Puts Rack-scale AI at Center of AMD’s Next Growth Phase

body.en: Su makes rack-scale systems, not single accelerators, the centre of AMD's next growth phase — the strategic shift behind the Helios line.
body.zh: 苏姿丰将机架级整机系统而非单颗加速器定为 AMD 下一阶段增长的核心，这是 Helios 系列背后的战略转向。

title.en: 苏姿丰ASIC布局又+1：AMD官宣收购Taalas 押注“模型即计算机”赛道
title.zh: 苏姿丰ASIC布局又+1：AMD官宣收购Taalas 押注“模型即计算机”赛道

body.en: AMD announced its acquisition of Taalas under Lisa Su, extending its ASIC strategy and betting on a 'model-as-computer' approach.
body.zh: 苏姿丰主导下，AMD官宣收购Taalas，进一步布局ASIC战略，押注「模型即计算机」路线。

title.en: 苏姿丰预估2027年AMD数据中心业务营收翻倍
title.zh: 苏姿丰预估2027年AMD数据中心业务营收翻倍

body.en: Su forecast that AMD's data center business revenue will double by 2027.
body.zh: 苏姿丰预测AMD数据中心业务营收将在2027年翻倍。

title.en: AMD苏姿丰：AI服务器Helios已全面投产，预计Q3末出货
title.zh: AMD苏姿丰：AI服务器Helios已全面投产，预计Q3末出货

body.en: Su says AMD's Helios AI server rack has entered full production and should ship by the end of Q3, putting the MI400-generation system she has staked AMD's datacenter case on into volume.
body.zh: 苏姿丰表示 AMD 的 Helios AI 服务器已全面投产，预计第三季度末出货，她押注数据中心业务的 MI400 世代整机开始规模交付。

title.en: Five thoughts from Lisa Su’s keynote at AMD Advancing AI
title.zh: Five thoughts from Lisa Su’s keynote at AMD Advancing AI

body.en: Analysis piece distilling five key takeaways from Lisa Su's keynote at AMD's Advancing AI 2026 event.
body.zh: 分析文章总结了苏姿丰在AMD 2026 Advancing AI大会主题演讲中的五个要点。

title.en: 全球首颗2nm GPU来了！苏姿丰甩出“最强AI机架”，CPU性能干翻英伟达
title.zh: 全球首颗2nm GPU来了！苏姿丰甩出“最强AI机架”，CPU性能干翻英伟达

body.en: Su unveiled AMD's first 2nm GPU and a new "strongest AI rack" system, claiming its CPU performance surpasses NVIDIA's.
body.zh: 苏姿丰发布AMD首款2nm GPU及全新"最强AI机架"系统，称其CPU性能超越英伟达。

title.en: 继英伟达黄仁勋后，AMD苏姿丰也表态支持开源AI模型
title.zh: 继英伟达黄仁勋后，AMD苏姿丰也表态支持开源AI模型

body.en: Following Nvidia's Jensen Huang, AMD CEO Lisa Su publicly voiced support for open-source AI models.
body.zh: 继英伟达黄仁勋之后，AMD首席执行官苏姿丰也公开表态支持开源AI模型。

title.en: 挑战英伟达！AMD机架级AI系统全面投产，苏姿丰称智能体兴起拉动GPU需求
title.zh: 挑战英伟达！AMD机架级AI系统全面投产，苏姿丰称智能体兴起拉动GPU需求

body.en: AMD's rack-scale AI systems entered full production, with Su citing surging agentic-AI demand for GPUs — a direct challenge to Nvidia's datacenter dominance.
body.zh: AMD机架级AI系统全面投产，苏姿丰表示智能体AI兴起正拉动GPU需求，这被视为对英伟达数据中心主导地位的直接挑战。

title.en: 全球首颗2nm GPU来了！苏姿丰甩出“最强AI机架”，CPU性能干翻英伟达
title.zh: 全球首颗2nm GPU来了！苏姿丰甩出“最强AI机架”，CPU性能干翻英伟达

body.en: AMD unveiled what it calls the world's first 2nm GPU alongside a new high-density AI rack platform, claiming a CPU performance edge over Nvidia.
body.zh: AMD发布号称全球首颗2nm GPU及新款高密度AI机架平台，并宣称CPU性能超越英伟达。

title.en: 继英伟达黄仁勋后，AMD苏姿丰也表态支持开源AI模型
title.zh: 继英伟达黄仁勋后，AMD苏姿丰也表态支持开源AI模型

body.en: Su went on record backing open-source AI models, following Jensen Huang, positioning AMD alongside NVIDIA in favor of open over closed model development.
body.zh: 继黄仁勋之后，苏姿丰也公开表态支持开源人工智能模型，使AMD在开源与闭源模型之争中与英伟达站在同一立场。

title.en: AMD CEO Lisa Su tells grads they shape the future, not AI
title.zh: AMD CEO Lisa Su tells grads they shape the future, not AI

body.en: In a commencement address, AMD CEO Lisa Su tells graduates that they, not AI, will shape the future.
body.zh: AMD CEO苏姿丰在毕业演讲中对毕业生表示，塑造未来的是他们自己，而非AI。

title.en: Lisa Su meets China's vice premier during China visit — AMD CEO pledges deeper investment days after Trump-Xi summit
title.zh: Lisa Su meets China's vice premier during China visit — AMD CEO pledges deeper investment days after Trump-Xi summit

body.en: Lisa Su met China's vice premier during a China visit and pledged deeper AMD investment in the country, days after the Trump-Xi summit.
body.zh: 苏姿丰在访华期间会见中国国务院副总理，并在特朗普与习近平会晤后不久承诺加大AMD在华投资。

title.en: 李开复对话苏姿丰：2026年，AI开始替代整个部门
title.zh: 李开复对话苏姿丰：2026年，AI开始替代整个部门

body.en: In a dialogue with Kai-Fu Lee, Lisa Su said AI will begin replacing entire departments in 2026, a notable public stance on AI's workplace impact.
body.zh: 在与李开复的对话中，苏姿丰表示2026年AI将开始替代整个部门，这是她对AI职场影响的一次重要公开表态。

title.en: 苏姿丰谈AMD对大中华区承诺：中国生态系统令人兴奋，我们的投资超出了需求
title.zh: 苏姿丰谈AMD对大中华区承诺：中国生态系统令人兴奋，我们的投资超出了需求

body.en: Lisa Su reaffirmed AMD's commitment to Greater China, saying the region's AI ecosystem is exciting and AMD's investment there already exceeds current demand.
body.zh: 苏姿丰重申AMD对大中华区的承诺，表示该地区的AI生态系统令人兴奋，AMD在当地的投资已超出当前需求。

title.en: 美国超威半导体公司董事会主席兼CEO苏姿丰：中国市场极其重要
title.zh: 美国超威半导体公司董事会主席兼CEO苏姿丰：中国市场极其重要

body.en: Su said the Chinese market remains extremely important to AMD, a stance notable given ongoing U.S. export restrictions on AI chips.
body.zh: 苏姿丰表示中国市场对AMD而言极其重要，这一表态在美国对AI芯片持续实施出口限制的背景下颇受关注。

title.en: 苏姿丰来华福利拉满：AMD官宣适配小米大模型、300万模型Day0支持+免费AI云上线
title.zh: 苏姿丰来华福利拉满：AMD官宣适配小米大模型、300万模型Day0支持+免费AI云上线

body.en: During a China visit, AMD announced day-zero support for Xiaomi's large language models plus a free AI cloud offering.
body.zh: 苏姿丰访华期间，AMD宣布为小米大模型提供Day 0支持，并推出免费AI云服务。

title.en: 苏姿丰现身上海：AMD 大中华区有超 4000 名工程师，预计 2030 年全球将有 50 亿人每日使用 AI
title.zh: 苏姿丰现身上海：AMD 大中华区有超 4000 名工程师，预计 2030 年全球将有 50 亿人每日使用 AI

body.en: Appearing in Shanghai, Su says AMD's Greater China team has over 4,000 engineers and predicts 5 billion people will use AI daily by 2030.
body.zh: 苏姿丰现身上海，表示AMD大中华区拥有超过4000名工程师，并预测到2030年全球将有50亿人每天使用AI。

title.en: 黄仁勋苏姿丰，投了田渊栋
title.zh: 黄仁勋苏姿丰，投了田渊栋

body.en: Report that Jensen Huang and Lisa Su personally invested in a venture by researcher Yuandong Tian, chip industry leaders backing AI research talent directly.
body.zh: 报道称黄仁勋与苏姿丰个人投资了研究员田渊栋的创业项目，芯片行业领袖直接支持AI研究人才。

title.en: AMD CEO苏姿丰：智能体正引爆人工智能周期巨大需求
title.zh: AMD CEO苏姿丰：智能体正引爆人工智能周期巨大需求

body.en: Su said AI agents are igniting a huge new wave of demand in the current AI computing cycle.
body.zh: 苏姿丰表示智能体正在为本轮AI计算周期引爆巨大的新增需求。

title.en: Lisa Su Hosts Howard Lutnick As Commerce Department Highlights 'Gold Standard' American Tech Stack: AMD C
title.zh: Lisa Su Hosts Howard Lutnick As Commerce Department Highlights 'Gold Standard' American Tech Stack: AMD C

body.en: Lisa Su hosted U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick at AMD as the department showcased AMD's role in the American tech supply chain.
body.zh: 苏姿丰在AMD接待美国商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克，美国商务部借此展示AMD在美国科技产业链中的地位。

title.en: 三星电子社长卢泰文会见AMD CEO苏姿丰，或扩大合作范围
title.zh: 三星电子社长卢泰文会见AMD CEO苏姿丰，或扩大合作范围

body.en: Samsung president Roh Tae-moon met AMD CEO Lisa Su to discuss potentially expanding their partnership.
body.zh: 三星电子社长卢泰文与AMD CEO苏姿丰会面,双方探讨可能扩大合作范围。

title.en: 对黄仁勋说“NO”！苏姿丰发动“去英伟达”战争
title.zh: 对黄仁勋说“NO”！苏姿丰发动“去英伟达”战争

body.en: Su was described as pushing AMD's "de-Nvidia" strategy, positioning the company as a direct alternative to Nvidia in AI chips.
body.zh: 报道称苏姿丰正在推动AMD的"去英伟达"战略，将公司定位为AI芯片领域对英伟达的直接替代选择。

title.en: AMD's Lisa Su says AI isn't replacing people, but is changing who gets hired
title.zh: AMD's Lisa Su says AI isn't replacing people, but is changing who gets hired

body.en: AMD CEO Lisa Su said AI isn't replacing workers but is changing who gets hired, a notable public stance on AI's labor-market impact from a major chipmaker's chief executive.
body.zh: AMD首席执行官苏姿丰表示，AI并非在取代员工，而是在改变企业招聘的对象，这是一位主要芯片厂商CEO对AI就业市场影响的重要公开表态。
